_comment: Provenance of openapi/openapi-v1.json and of the models generated from it. Written only by `python openapi/regen.py --refresh --upstream <document>`, and read by `python openapi/regen.py --check`. Every value is derived from content: the same upstream document writes the same file on every machine.

upstream._role: The upstream public OpenAPI document the vendored spec was produced from, identified by the SHA-256 of its bytes and the info.version it declares. `--check --upstream <document>` re-reads a supplied copy and requires both this hash and the transform result to match.

vendored._role: openapi/openapi-v1.json, the input to code generation. Its bytes are pinned to LF by .gitattributes, so this hash holds for every checkout and archive.
vendored.transform: openapi/regen.py:_to_customer_gateway_spec; UTF-8 sorted JSON, two-space indent, LF with final newline
